dslRule:
<!id: simplify.single.string.array.to.varargs>
<!description: Replace single-element String array with its element when passed to a varargs method.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.String[] { $arg } :: isPassedToMethod() && instanceof($arg, "java.lang.String")
=> $arg
;;
summary: Simplifies passing a single-element String array to a varargs method by replacing the array creation with its sole element, improving readability and leveraging Java 5+ varargs.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
